episodes.title: Piloto
episodes.summary: After seven years in prison, a male stripper is unexpectedly granted a retrial.  Released on parole, he hunts for proof he was framed for murder.

episodes.title: De entre los muertos
episodes.summary: Hugo finds a way to get a close look at the coroner's wrecked car.  Triana follows a suspicious money trail to Melilla.  Andrea makes an unlikely friend.

episodes.title: El juicio final
episodes.summary: When Andrea hints his accident on the night of the murder was a coverup, Hugo searches in hospital records to see if Macarena's alibi checks out.

episodes.title: Casilla de salida
episodes.summary: Hugo scrambles to hide the fact that he left Inferno at the time of the new murder.  Andrea is approached by an old friend's mother, who makes a plea.

episodes.title: El pulso del asesino
episodes.summary: Triana notices Philip's smartwatch is missing from police evidence, then realizes its data is likely on the cloud.  Macarena learns more about Alvera.

episodes.title: El final del túnel
episodes.summary: An ID is made on the body found on the boat, but doubt leads Hugo to check its veracity.  Macarena discovers Alvaro's mother knows her son's whereabouts.

episodes.title: Juego de máscaras
episodes.summary: Under hypnosis, Hugo remembers key details of the night he was framed.  Philip's smartwatch is found.  Claudia must choose between her husband and Ivan.

episodes.title: Único testigo
episodes.summary: Ivan makes sudden travel plans.  A new police commissioner takes Zapata by surprise.  Andrea receives an unexpected gift from his uncle Mateo.

episodes.title: Amor de madre
episodes.summary: Hugo steals from his captor evidence that leads him to the killer behind the charred body.  Andrea calls Jairo for help.  Oscar gets a tempting job offer.

episodes.title: Polaroids
episodes.summary: Andrea receives a threatening message.  Macarena is directed to a safe containing a mysterious flash drive.  Zapata forces Ivan to do a favor for him.

episodes.title: Cachorro
episodes.summary: Macarena is stunned by a betrayal.  Triana gives the commissioner the evidence from the gas station.  Jairo receives a lucrative offer.

episodes.title: Redención
episodes.summary: Triana discovers Ivan is hiding a secret about Inferno.  When Andrea's flash drive is stolen from Jairo, the Inferno gang go undercover to get it back.

episodes.title: Ángeles caídos
episodes.summary: The Irish mafia come looking for the money taken from their club.  A video is leaked to the press.  Hugo comes face-to-face with the rapist-murderer.

episodes.title: La persona a la que mas quieres
episodes.summary: Hugo aggressively searches for answers about who bombed Inferno. Macarena starts making amends. The strippers perform for a new client.

episodes.title: ¿Qué es el amor para ti?
episodes.summary: Despite Iván's objections, Hugo takes a risk while investigating Rania. Macarena is curious to learn more about El Turco.

episodes.title: El precio de los dioses
episodes.summary: Rania tries to find a missing David before her brother. Hugo goes against his moral code in order to pay for Triana's medical care.

episodes.title: Cielo e infierno
episodes.summary: El Turco uses unorthodox methods to woo Macarena. Meanwhile, his sister gets closer to Iván. Andrea shows off his film idea inspired by Jairo.

episodes.title: Templos profanos
episodes.summary: Triana struggles to regain her strength. El Turco desperately searches for Rania and the trail he follows leads to a stunning accusation.

episodes.title: Un gesto de amor
episodes.summary: A visit from an old friend surprises Hugo. After consulting with his lawyer, Andrea makes a decision about his future. El Turco plans a grand gesture.

episodes.title: ¿Por qué me llaman el turco?
episodes.summary: Hugo tries to help Darío find work. Behind El Turco's back, an unexpected alliance forms against him. Borja has a difficult request for Macarena.

episodes.title: Puertas que se abren
episodes.summary: Macarena and El Turco prepare for their wedding day. Hugo and Triana find themselves in a dangerous situation. Andrea is dealt a crushing blow.
